cost_pooling.nodes_per_root: maximum across the three final seed reports in the domain
cost_pooling.tree_seconds_per_root: maximum across the three final seed reports in the domain
cost_pooling.effective_unique_aggressive_branches_per: maximum across the three final seed reports in the domain
cost_pooling.peak_rss_bytes: maximum across the three seed reports; diagnostic only
cost_pooling.full_training_seconds_per_root: maximum across the three seed reports; trainability diagnostic only, not the strategic cost-rank metric
cost_pooling.reason: One cheap seed must never hide a materially more expensive seed. Strategic cost uses tree-only timing; the separate 90-day trainability gate uses complete checkpoint-to-checkpoint/final-work timing on the physical Ryzen.

cross_seed_stability.policy_independence: The corpus is generated without consulting any of the three trained policies being compared. Frozen training-seed integers are used only as deterministic corpus RNG namespaces.
cross_seed_stability.comparison: For each common state, evaluate the same candidate action specification under all three finalized AveragePolicies and compute the three pairwise total-variation distances.
cross_seed_stability.gate_role: hard eligibility gate, never a relative strategic ranking metric

omission_weighting.state_source: PF_DENSE_REFERENCE traversal under the frozen referee AveragePolicy
omission_weighting.weighting: Each sampled decision visit has unit empirical weight. Therefore the arithmetic mean over sampled visits is the precommitted visitation-frequency-weighted mean; no post-hoc street/SPR/candidate reweighting is allowed.
omission_weighting.percentiles: nearest-rank on the per-state positive-loss sample

assembly_rules: Every candidate/domain requires exactly the three frozen final seed reports.
Every final seed report must be R7.5.4A-160, C0, iteration-5 post-policy-fit, and must not authorize production or table use.
All three per-seed advantage/policy fit gates and the candidate/domain cross-seed gate must pass for strategic eligibility.
PF_DENSE_REFERENCE remains diagnostic/referee and cannot win; incomplete or invalid PF_DENSE evidence blocks strategic pruning.
R7.5.4A-160 may prune only. It cannot make the final production sizing selection.
No result under this freeze can set production_training_authorized or ready_for_tables true.
